-- Recursive records remain records. These declarations are compile-only:
-- no finite canonical value of either recursive record is constructed or run.
structure Sh1RecursiveRecord where
  next : Sh1RecursiveRecord

def sh1RecursiveRecordObserve (value : Sh1RecursiveRecord) : Nat :=
  match value with
  | Sh1RecursiveRecord.mk next => 0

def sh1RecursiveRecordStep (value : Sh1RecursiveRecord) : Nat :=
  match value with
  | Sh1RecursiveRecord.mk next => sh1RecursiveRecordStep next

structure Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord (alpha : Type) where
  item : alpha
  next : Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord alpha

def sh1RecursiveGenericObserve {alpha : Type}
    (value : Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord alpha) : alpha :=
  match value with
  | Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord.mk item next => item

def sh1RecursiveGenericStep {alpha : Type}
    (value : Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord alpha) : alpha :=
  match value with
  | Sh1RecursiveGenericRecord.mk item next => sh1RecursiveGenericStep next

sourceArgument: Both record families are regular, index-free, uniformly parameterized positive one-constructor declarations. The recursive field is first for the monomorphic family and second for the generic family; the other generic field has type T0.

Each observer discards its generated IH. Each step uses exactly the root-established child IH. Its new original-IR body must retain the current declaration call on the projected next field, so a lowering that indiscriminately discards all IHs cannot pass.
The original-IR expectation comes from the raw fixture telescope and actual Model fields, independently of erasure's metadata cache. Expected projection order follows the authored record fields.

Every major is captured once, and each projection reads that fresh immutable major. Field and major binder names are read from actual IR and checked distinct; the raw observer result or single recursive call is checked after the exact field prefix, excluding a leftover IH lambda.

Source Declaration d191 emits only family/constructor/recursor members. CheckedAdmissions35bc encodes their family/constructor types as an ordinary inductive admission and skips separate constructor/recursor records. No projection declaration or new Core.proj term is introduced by these match-only witnesses or the new Expr lowering.

The frozen ordinary inductive checker accepts positive direct self fields with the same parameters and constructs minors with field binders followed by recursive hypotheses. Native Lean 4.34 infer_proj independently has no isRec restriction, but no executed provider or native record-value evidence is claimed.

These families have no finite canonical inhabitant. That limits runtime observations, not required translation of their accepted ordinary functions. No fabricated cyclic record, Empty inhabitant, extra grammar feature, evaluator case or compiler invocation is added.
